checks.label: Arrivals still outstanding
checks.detail: An arrival left unchecked at roll-over becomes a no-show, and the retention posts against it.

checks.label: Departures not yet checked out
checks.detail: A room still showing due out holds its inventory into tomorrow.

checks.label: In-house folios carrying a balance
checks.detail: These roll forward. Nothing is wrong with that — it is worth seeing before it happens.

checks.label: Room charges to post
checks.detail: One night's tariff and tax per occupied room. Day-use stays are excluded — they have already been charged.

checks.label: Rooms still marked dirty
checks.detail: Not a blocker. A room left dirty overnight is a room the morning shift inherits.

checks.label: Postings reversed today
checks.detail: Every reversal is somebody correcting something. Worth reading before the day closes.
